items.title: Barracuda Networks is your new best friend (Barracuda Email Security Gateway Pre-Auth Remote Root RCE CVE-2026-116606 / CVE-2026-111560)
items.summary: What Is A Barracuda, And Why? Must We? Barracuda’s Email Security Gateway solution (ESG) is no stranger to love, for a couple of reasons: For many, it is the appliance that sits in front of an organization's mail and decides which messages are spam, which carry malware, and which are allowed through. For others, it’s the appliance that required physical replacement after UNC4841 (per Mandiant) exploited CVE-2023-2868 as a zero-day. Whoever you are, one thing will be consistent in your experience: it is yet another appliance that lives at the edge, inspects everything, and runs with the exact and only privileges needed to block a mean email about your blog post.

items.title: DoJ's 'Super Intelligence Task Force' up and running
items.summary: The US Department of Justice (DoJ) says its Super Intelligence Task Force (SINTF) is now up and running, after president Donald Trump ordered the move in a memo last month. Headed up by director of national intelligence Jay Clayton, as well as associate attorney general Stanley Woodward and associate deputy attorney general Stephen Weiss, SINTF's responsibility is to protect the US's lead in artificial intelligence development. Thursday's announcement, which was littered with the "super intelligence" Trumpism, said the task force will ensure the US's SI/AI leadership remains uncompromised by foreign AI "abuse," including by state and state-backed groups, criminal enterprises, individuals, or corporate entities.

items.title: Datakeskuksille järisyttävä käänne USA:ssa: "Uusi päivä koittaa"
items.summary: Datakeskushankkeet ovat puhuttaneet meillä Suomessa, mutta Yhdysvalloissa ne olivat osaltaan varmistamassa demokraateille murskavoittoa tämän viikon välivaaleissa. Tekoälybuumista hyötyvillä yrityksillä on ollut kissanpäivät presidentti Donald Trumpin hallinnon aikaan varsinkin, kun myös paikallispolitiikkaa ovat johtaneet laajalti republikaanit. – Datakeskuspäätöksiä tehdään paljon paikallistasolla, ja demokraatit menestyivät hyvin myös siellä. Joten siellä on vastatuulta, arvioi Nordean pääanalyytikko Jan von Gerich kommentoi MTV:n Asian ytimessä -ohjelmalle keskiviikkoiltana. Wall Steet -analytikko Dan Ives antoi konkreettisen arvionsa vaalituloksen vaikutuksista datakeskuksille. Hän kutsuu sinistä vyöryä "järisyttäväksi käänteeksi", joka vaikuttaa Yhdysvaltojen tekoälyvallankumoukseen tulevien vuosien aikana.

items.title: US Government Email Systems Open to Abuse Thanks to Typos
items.summary: Simple oversights in domain name system (DNS) records are exposing government organizations to all kinds of potential impersonation, spying, and more. In a new study of more than 25,000 government-related domains, SH Consulting founder Alex Shakhov found dozens whose DNS records referenced either mistyped, expired, or otherwise repurposed domains. Though few in number, those vulnerable included all sorts of agencies representing US towns, cities, counties, regulatory boards, and more. Many of the erroneous records pointed to domains that were either available to, or already snapped up by, attackers. Depending on the nature of the error, they could allow attackers to send or receive email on behalf of vulnerable government agencies, reconfigure their DNS records, read their security records, and more.

items.title: White House IP Addresses Sold Through Proxy Services
items.summary: Devices on the White House network are being used as proxies allowing outside users to appear as if they come from the president's office, researchers found. Security firm Layer3 Intel stumbled on the White House network while probing services that sell access to everyday devices for traffic reroute. It found that 28 residential proxy services provided access to the Washington network. Between Oct. 5 and Nov. 3, those providers routed researchers' internet traffic through six White House IP addresses hundreds of times. "We did not selectively target this network or try to make our probes exit from it," Layer3 Intel said Wednesday in a blog. "We caught this by chance, simply by requesting global rotating access through these services." Traffic from the White House devices showed up between 5 p.m. and midnight and almost none in the early morning. The pattern suggests that it came from a person powering on the devices and regularly working late rather than a public guest Wi-Fi, Layer3 Intel said.

items.title: DigiCert admits 16-month security lapse exposed customer information
items.summary: DigiCert has admitted that a botched server migration left an internal system exposed to the internet for more than a year, allowing an unauthorized user to access customer data, including passports, driver's licenses, and other identity documents. The certificate authority has begun notifying affected customers but has yet to disclose how many people had their information exposed. In an email seen by The Register, DigiCert confirmed the compromised information included names, business email addresses, phone numbers, and business addresses. Some records may also have contained passports, driver's licenses, utility bills, or other identification documents. DigiCert's incident report traces the blunder back to February 2025, when an internal business system was moved from a VPN-protected network to a different availability zone. That change also opened the system up to the public internet, where it sat for more than 16 months without DigiCert realizing.

items.title: Analyysi: Pommiuhkaus voi lamauttaa lentoliikenteen ilman yhtäkään räjähdettä
items.summary: BERLIINI Kymmenet perättömät pommiuhkaukset ovat pakottaneet matkustajalentoja laskeutumaan ja häirinneet lentoliikennettä viime päivinä. Räjähteitä ei ole löydetty, mutta uhkaukset käynnistivät kalliit turvallisuusoperaatiot. Ruokakauppojen kylmälaitteisiin tehtiin viime viikolla kyberhyökkäyksiä eri puolilla Eurooppaa, ja kaupat joutuivat heittämään pois valtavat määrät sulanutta ruokaa. Ranskassa rikolliset iskivät kansallisen veripalvelun kolmeen kylmävarastoon alkuviikosta. Kylmälaitteiden lämpötila-asetuksia oli nostettu jopa 110 asteeseen. Yhteistä tapauksille on, että suhteellisen pienillä teoilla pystyttiin aiheuttamaan suurta vahinkoa.
